about: The collecta of the formulary “Second Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Almighty, everlasting God, Who rulest at once the things of heaven and of earth, mercifully hear the supplications of Thy people and grant Thy peace in our times. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
